Synopsis:
    Former British glam-rock star Gary Glitter (Paul Gadd, 82) pleaded not guilty at Southwark Crown Court to eight historic sex offence charges relating to alleged abuse of a young girl between 1978 and 1981. He appeared via video link from prison and was remanded in custody pending trial next year.
